title: MONDAY LEGS AND BALANCE
subtitle: EASY LEGS AND STEADY BALANCE. ALL SEATED FIRST, THEN STANDING AT THE CHAIR. NO FLOOR TODAY. KIND HIPS.

script.welcome: Good morning Pam. I'm Stratton. Monday is legs and balance, about eleven minutes, nice and steady. In the chair we'll warm up with gentle knee lifts and a light figure four. Then a few easy sit to stands, and we finish standing at the chair with a kind hip flexor stretch and a little balance. No floor today. A smaller range is fine on sore-joint days. Well done for starting the week with me.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat, shoulders soft, and take one slow easy breath.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Settle in. No rush at all.
script.lastSet: Last one of these. Keep it comfortable.
script.complete: That's us, Pam. Legs awake, balance steady, hips looked after. A proper good start to the week. Have a sip of water and enjoy your Monday. Well done.
script.pause: Paused. Take all the time you need.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED GENTLE KNEE LIFTS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of the chair, hands resting on the seat edges. Slowly lift one knee a few inches like an easy seated march, lower, then the other side. Keep the left knee lift small so nothing pinches at the front of the hip. A smaller lift is fine on sore-joint days. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Gentle knee lifts to wake the legs. Eight each leg, twice through. Sit tall and lift one knee slowly, only a few inches. Keep the left side small.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Feet down. Slow breath.
exercises.speakDone: Knee lifts done. Legs warm and ready, Pam.

exercises.name: SEATED FIGURE-FOUR (LIGHT)
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of the chair, feet flat. Rest the right ankle over the left thigh, just above the knee. Stay tall and tip forward from the hips only a touch, until you feel a mild stretch in the outer hip. Hold about twenty seconds, then switch sides. Never press the knee down or fold deep. If the left groin or front of the hip pinches, skip that side or simply rest the ankle without leaning. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Seated figure four, nice and light. About twenty seconds each side. Rest one ankle over the other thigh, sit tall, and tip forward just a touch. Skip the left side if it pinches.
exercises.speakDone: Figure four done. Hips nice and loose.

exercises.name: EASY SIT-TO-STAND
exercises.cue: Sit near the front of the chair, feet flat and hip-width apart, a little behind the knees. Lean forward slightly and stand up slowly, using your hands on the seat or thighs as much as you like. Stand tall for a breath, then sit back down gently with control. No bouncing. On sore-joint days use more hand help or do fewer. Keep the lean small so nothing pinches at the front of the hip. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Easy sit to stands. Five slow ones, twice through. Feet flat, lean forward a touch, and stand up slowly. Use your hands as much as you like. Then sit back down gently.
exercises.speakRest: Thirty seconds. Sit and breathe. After the second set, stay standing and come round to the chair back.
exercises.speakDone: Sit to stands done. Strong legs, Pam. Stay up and come round to the chair back.

exercises.name: STANDING HIP FLEXOR
exercises.cue: Stand beside the chair with one hand lightly on the chair back. Step one foot back about half a step, not a deep lunge, both feet pointing forward, knees soft. Gently tuck the pelvis under until you feel a mild stretch at the front of the back hip. A tiny lean is enough. Breathe slowly for about twenty seconds, then swap. Start with the left leg back and keep that side extra gentle. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Standing hip flexor. About twenty seconds each leg. Hand on the chair, small step back, tuck the pelvis, tiny lean. Left leg first, extra gentle.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Feet together. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Hip flexor stretch done. Front of the hips looked after.

exercises.name: CHAIR-SUPPORTED BALANCE
exercises.cue: Stand tall behind the chair with both hands resting lightly on the back. Shift your weight onto one foot and lift the other heel, or the whole foot, just off the floor. Keep the standing knee soft, tummy gently in, eyes ahead. Hold about fifteen seconds, then switch. Grip the chair as much as you need; toes touching down is perfectly fine. Keep the lifted leg low and relaxed so nothing pinches at the front of the hip.
exercises.speakStart: Chair balance to finish. About fifteen seconds each leg, twice through. Hands on the chair, lift one foot just off the floor, stand tall. Toes can touch down any time.
exercises.speakDone: Balance done. That's the session, Pam. Legs and balance, ticked off. Have a lovely Monday.
